items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: All right. That was written by Dick Grove and myself.

ctx.x: Tell me about this tune, “Little Bird.”

All right. That was written by Dick Grove and myself. Dick Grove had a wonderful rehearsal band, great arrangements, a great arranger. You know he just passed on, not too long ago. And every Tuesday or Wednesday he would rehearse in the rehearsal band and I’d go down and either sit in with the band or listen, and Dick would say, “You want to play a couple of tunes with the band?” So there was one chart he had where I was able to take that one little line he had and made a tune out of it, “Little Bird.” So I…
Dick. I said, “Dick, I think you should get half of this.” Because he didn’t remember it. But I said this is —
